title: Date of Birth
description: A person's date of birth. The Sorcha formatMaximum token 'today' bounds the date picker to the past. NOTE: this bound is enforced by the RENDERER ONLY — formatMaximum has no server-side consumer, so a future date submitted directly to the API is accepted and sealed. Do not rely on it as a validation constraint (see issue #1469).
